messages:
Alex Kim: Heads-up — during the simulated routing-canary this morning we saw 95th/99th authz check latency spikes when route-affinity fallback triggered. Not huge but it pushed a few requests over our RPC SLO. Anyone else see this?
Miriam Ortega: yeah noticed in the console traces. spike corresponds to authz service cold DB reads after cache miss. root cause looked like scope-expansion call doing a backend call per-route.
Samir Patel: rough numbers? latency at 99th?
Alex Kim: 95th ~ 120ms, 99th ~ 420ms for the authz check (our token flow normally < 30ms). end-to-end added ~400ms for affected requests.
Jihoon Park: Oof. That's enough to trigger SLO alerts. Did we sample spans to see which routes or tenants?
Miriam Ortega: sampling was coarse. We had 1% sampling on production. For canary we ramped to 10% but still sparse for low-traffic tenants.
Samir Patel: Can we add a lightweight counter that emits a histogram per-route of authz latencies (no payload) to CloudMetrics? minimal overhead.
Alex Kim: Agree — a histogram + tenant tag would help. Also consider bypassing full scope expansion if token already contains scope claim; do optimistic fast path.
Jihoon Park: Caveat: optimistic fast path needs strict correctness for dedicated/private customers. Might need per-tenant feature flag.
Miriam Ortega: For rollout: plan = add metric + trace span -> add feature flag + opt-fast-path for non-enterprise tenants -> canary at 5% -> 25% -> full.
Samir Patel: Also need fallback: if authz latency > X ms, route to cheaper model variant or shorter seq to avoid cascading SLA miss. Should be in routing policy.
Alex Kim: Good point. Add policy flag 'authz_slo_override' that signals runtime to prefer low-latency model variant.
Ava (oncall): Preference: make it observable in console with an alert enrichment: show last authz histogram + tenant sample traces. Oncall needs quick triage.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: authz-metrics-proxy v2 -> canary group A at 01:30 UTC.
Miriam Ortega: I'll draft the telemetry PR and the rollout playbook. Assigning tasks: @Alex Kim to add routing policy flag, @Samir Patel to add histograms, @Jihoon Park to implement feature-flag gating, @Miriam Ortega to PR + playbook.
Alex Kim: assigned, starting now. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: timeline?
Miriam Ortega: PRs today, canary tomorrow, roll forward if no regressions.
Jihoon Park: I'll add tests for dedicated-tenant behavior.
Ava (oncall): If we see >0.5% of requests hitting authz >500ms, auto rollback.
Alex Kim: noted. Also need a small UI affordance in Console per-route rules showing 'AuthZ fallback' enabled/disabled. I'll open a ticket.
Miriam Ortega: thanks all.
